description: This file defines a class 'hooks' with a method 'load_js' that handles loading specific JavaScript files based on certain request parameters and module mappings in a SuiteCRM extension. It interacts with external mapping PHP files for Facebook and Twitter integrations and outputs script tags conditionally.

classes.name: hooks
classes.description: A class defining methods related to social media hook functionalities, particularly loading JavaScript assets based on request context.

methods.name: load_js
methods.description: Handles conditional loading of JavaScript files for Facebook and Twitter integrations within the SuiteCRM module, based on request parameters and module mappings.
